home.researchText: mesenkaca biyak kalalaanam duuduntaa? Misinkaca digir koo catelee? Soomuuy, maaqooy, xin kee ankacsu wagittam hay? qaduuk, raceenaani gacsitte, sumaq boola edde anuk.
home.appText: currik tan app offline taamitam kee buxah marih fotot doortam duddah, isi aalatal koppi innal daffessa. Inkibisle sabhalal le goolisso: affara kaxxa balaaqitte, wakti lowsiise, ximmo mali.

faq.q: Taphaa gaarii nama umurii guddaa-ittaan maal?
faq.a: Taphaa gaarii sabbaa, beekamaa fi dhiphina hin qabnee: suuraa guddaa walitti madaalchuu, qoodu, wal-bu'ii salphaa, jechoota beekamoo xumuruu, halluu, bingo suuraa fi kaardii dubbii. Namoota umurii guddaa hedduu-ittaan, dementia qabu-ittaan hammatti, ni tolu. Filannoon gaarii kan yeroo ammaa namichi jaalatu. Yeroo, qabxii fi wanti qormaata fakkaatu hin barbaachisu.
Yeey. Kulli digir kee dahabak yan uddur yatbiqeenim currik tan, akkaawonti sinnim, asta akkek oobisiyya sinnim. Digir elle yakkem qarok-qariita birowseril silkil, tableet akkek kompiiteril.

Taphaa tokkollee dementia ittisuu agarame hin jiru, Creative Activities garuu wanta hunda-ittaan yaaluu yookaan ittisuu hin ibsu. Taphaan keenya boonaa fi yeroo wal-bira qabaachuuf; fuula tuutaa hunda keessatti ibsa fayyaa hin jiru.

faq.q: Tama digir Alzheimer leh yan numuh bictaa?
faq.a: Yeey. Alzheimer biyak kaxxaam mangoh tan dementia biyak kinnim kee tama biyak elle geytimam: kaxxa taswiir elle geytimam, doorit dagoom, kee kassitam kee taqabi lem hinna. ramaddos, uxuxxos kee gaba kalti buxa marih maxcooca qusba barittok muxxi xer waktih ixxigal rakuh tan.

faq.q: inki num sarra caddo le dementiya too abnissoosat yantifiqem duudaa?
faq.a: Mango way, yeey, ken xaqut yan num lih. Qimmis gorris inkibisle namma taswiiril, taswiir nammaytakkoh affara balaaqitte, bisi gali hinnay sabhalal le ufuyrubtih soolo. uxxuk dacris, ken miraaciino katayaay oson duudaanah yanin wak soolis.

fanteena cisab maliiy maysaxxaga mali. nanu googil makeelissot nantifiqem manni galitte guftam cednuh. atu doorteh tan muucitte muucitte nammay takkoh dubuk ku birowseril tanbulleem kee qigdu matakka.
Creative Activities garee xiqqoo tuutaa sanaatiyaa nama kalaa hunda-ittaan, weebii fi appii bilaa-kaffal-ittaan hojjetu. Nu ogeessota fayyaa miti, wanti asitti jiru gorsa fayyaa miti.

about.lede: Creative Activities hojii nagaa fi namoota gurguddoo lamaan wal-bira ta'anii gammachuu danda'an dhiyeessa, kunis namni tokko kan biraa kunuunsu ta'uu yookaan wal-bira turuu barbaadan ta'uu danda'a.
about.bodyHtml:
Eenyuuf ta'a

Namni kunuunsu hundaaf: abbaa ykn haadha, akaakuu ykn ijoollee, michuu, jaalala ykn hiriyaa, ykn namni dementia jiraatu. Maatiin, namoota umurii dheeraa qaban fi hojjettoonni hojii hawaasaa hundinuu fuula isa tokko ni fayyadamu.

Waanti nu amanu

Hojiin bu'aa isaa yeroo isaa dha: marii, bashannanaa, gammachuu fakkii lama walitti ida'uu, ykn dhiyoo wal-bira teessuu qofa. Namoota madaalchuu, dhiibuu ykn wanti tokko akka ta'e mirkaneessuu miti.

Appii leenjii yaadaa baay'ee saffisaa, qabxii, dheekkamsa fi sadarkaa irratti hundaa'an. Namni dhukkubsate, dhukkubsate ykn dementia jiraatu tokkoof, kunis akka qormaata hin injifatamne ta'a. Nu garuu kan faallaa isaa ijaarre, akkasumas seerota kanaaf of-kennine:

  • Kufuu hin qabu. Sa'aatii, qabxii, lakkoofsa tarkaanfii, jireenya, walitti-fufiinsa, bashannanaa ykn lakkaa duubatti hin jiru, mudaa fakkii kamiyyuu irratti.
  • Beekuu ol, yaadachuu gadi. Fakkiin yeroo hunda mul'ata. Gorsi marii kaasuuf ta'a malee maqaa ykn yaadota qorachuuf miti.
  • Guddaa, ifa fi jabaa. Barreeffamni fi fakkiin guddaa, bifa ifa qabu, fi to'achuun bakka isaa jiraatu.
  • Ulfina namummaa. Fakkii addunyaa dhugaa fi jechoota ifa, ulfaataa ta'an. Fakkii hadhaa, galateeffannaa aarii fi badhaasa emoji hin qabu.
  • Bahuu salphaa. “Amma dhaabbadhu” yeroo hunda mul'ata. Gara walakkaa dhaabbachuunis bu'aa gaarii dha.
  • Dhokfamaa dursaan. Akkaawuntii ykn beeksisa hin qabu. Fakkii atii filattu meeshaa keetti hafa.

Waan nu hin mirkaneessine

Taphoonni fi hojiiwwan keenya gammachuu fi walitti dhufuuf. Dementia ykn dhukkuba Alzheimer's hin adda baasu, hin qorru, hin safaru, hin hambisu, hin gadi buusu, hin ittisu; namni kamiyyuu sababa kanaaf filachuu hin qabu. Qorannoo fayyaa barreessinu, dadhabina qorannoo sana ifatti ni ibsuu, hojiiwwan keenyaa waliin hin walqabsiisu.

Eenyu nu ta'e

Creative Activities garee walabaa xiqqaa dha. Nu ogeessota fayyaa miti. Giidiiwwan keenya waa'ee dhaabbilee akka National Institute on Aging fi Alzheimer’s Association irraa barreeffamaan qopheefamu, giidii hundinuu madda isaa ni tarreessa. Akkaataa barreessinu fi sirreessinu ilaali.

Wanta nu gargaaru nu himi

Waan siif hojjetu fi kan hin hojjetin nu dhageessuu barbaanna, keessumaa namoota dementia jiraatan, maatii kunuunsan fi hojjettoota hojii hawaasaa. Nu email {email} irratti barreessi.

editorial.title: Nanu ninni galitte mannal naktubeeh, cubbusnaah
editorial.description: Akkaataa Creative Activities itti qorannoo gochuu, barreessuu, madda kennuu fi fayyaa fi hojii keenya haaromsuu, fi waan hin maxxansine.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

items.q: Taphoonni namoota umurii dheeraa qabanii kan caalaa gaarii maali?
items.a: tayse digir buxa mariino, sahlin kee currik yan gutqo, kee numma tiya faxe num asaaku ruffa edde iyya. Taswiir yanbulle taswiir luk angaaraw, qaynat, sahlin jigsaw, buxah addah qangor gaba kalti, qaynat kee taswiir bingo inkih mango marah meqennal taamita. wakti yayyaaqe maraay, ximmoomaa kee aqayyaare celtah tan faxeemik soolis.
Yeey. Inkih tan digirittee kee matbaqatitte currik tan, akkaawonti sinnim, asta sinnim, oobisiyya akkek maysaxxaga sinnim.

items.q: Xalitteey, caddooda akkek waktitte kah ane waytam macaay?
items.a: Sissikaane kee xalitte rufto le abnisso aqayyaareh korsan, woh wacarriy akkek bakcarra bahtam duuddah. Nanu hangi kah naceem ruftoo kee wakti sittalih, tonnal tu raddam matan kee atu faxe ximmol soolissam duddah.

faxe silki, tableet akkek kompiter uddurtiino le qarok-qariitâ birowseril. tarbeezal solta tableet mango uddur namma num tattab tattab elle digran innah kaxxam bicale gita. TV lih axawah tan laptop buttah meqennal taamita.

items.q: Nanu ninni buxah marih muucittel digirram dudnaa?
items.a: Yeey. muuci nammay takkoh 2 ilaa 6 muuci atu doorte digir fan korissa. muucitte ku birowseril sugtaah, takrimtam akkek daanimtam madudda.

items.q: Inki abnisso magideh uddur sugtam faxxintaah?
items.a: mango uddur 10 ilaa 20 minit mangom, kee inki inki adda 2 minit mayso. ecla akkek bakcarra astooti wagitaay uxih meqem cussutta wak soolis. Massat tan caddo matan.

items.q: oson abnisso abaanam faxe weenik macaay?
items.a: Aleey massakaxxaay, sarra akkek baxsale gital qagitaak gibbat. Ciniyya kak tamaatem eclaay, biyaakaay, asmat sinna akkek uxxuuk fayxi alle waanama. oson bale iyyan wak maca abaanam faxximtam ni miracsenta wagita.

Raat kee qangooruk: kicintoh tan muuziik ankacisaanam, lotion luk gaba massage abaanam, fotot itta luk wagiitaanam, sissik qanxaffe luk gexaanam, irol daffeyna, hinnay kaxxaam sahlin taswiir digir keenik xaqut yan num luk abaanam. nek sarra caddoh miracsenta mango mablooli le.

Yeey. Taswiir bingo matbaqah karditte kee on-screen caller le, kee gaba kalti yab kee walal karditte meqennal taamitta. Ni buxah hanaawih buttah miracsenta buttah mangaay, daffeynaa kee tengeggele dudditte bartaanam duudumtah.

items.q: Digir mesenkaca biyak kalalam akkek salcisam duudaa?
items.a: Wali digir mayanbulla dementia kalaloonuh, kee ni digir tannah yan yoh taguudeh essero maaba. Ayyuntiinô caddol cognitive stimulation lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, lowsis gubat haak, baxsa le. Nanu digir xayyosnam ruftoo kee fantaaxaw.

Asmatah hinna. Kusaq 14 Takke Qaafiyat Kee Manô Caagiidal Dementiyah Qawwalayla Lih Angaaraw Lem Qaddoosen, Axcih Maabbiyyi Dacayrih, Fayya Le Qabli Giffa, Dagar Diig Angaaraw Kee Ayyuntiinô Baxsi. Ken aracat haanam inki inki maritteh qawwalayla salcisaanam bictah, takkay immay mango mari kullim meqennal abak uxih dementia biyak le. Qigdu numtin qellat hinna.

items.q: garuq sinni soom mesenkaca qaafiyatah meqee?
items.a: Sahdayti sumaq waado leeh udurruteh, kee mango kusaq saqi addat yan. Soom idoola, baxsa luk sokkar biyak daylitte hinnay qilsa lowsiisoonuh, kee dementia luk yan marah mafaxximta. Atu elle takme gurra milaagtaamak naharal daylaabe lih yab.

Aleey akkaawontitte akkek maysaxxagoogi matan. Nanu Google Analytics wagsiisak gufneh lowsis kee manni galitteh cato abnam kee ku browser kassitam atu lowsis xongoloola lowsissa. atu doorteh tan muucitte nammaytakkoh muucitte qigdu matakka. Addatinoh cankâ maysaxxaga wagita.

reasons.photos: Nooc warqad ma jiro. Ciyaartan waxay isticmaashaa sawirradaada, kuwaas oo ku sii jira browser-kaaga oo aan marna la soo rarin, sidaas darteed barta ma daabici karto. Si warqad lagu ciyaaro, dhowr sawir oo aad jeceshahay labo nuqul ku daabac guriga oo miiska ku isku mid samee.
reasons.paced: Nooc warqad ma jiro. Wareegga shaashadda wuxuu dejiyaa xawaare tartiib leh oo joogto ah, bog la daabacay ma sameyn karo taas, sidaas darteed waxay noqon lahayd hawl kale. Nasasho jiif ah oo wada ah oo aan shaashad lahayn had iyo jeer waa ikhtiyaar.
reasons.turns: Taphni kana akka waraqaatti hin jiru. Jiroota tapha 'Picture pairs' irraa kaardii suuraa maxxansiisii, hidhaa hidhaan garaa garaa keessaa ni baatu.
reasons.screen: Akka waraqaatti hin jiru. Kun suura gidduutti ilaalaa ta'uu kan qabu, suuraa jaallatame yookiin kaardii isaa tokko kan qabu sana tokko.
reasons.wash: Akka waraqaatti hin jiru. Suurri bisaan waraqaa irra kaa'amu wal fakkaata: burushii jiidhaa fi halkan tokko yeroo tokko.
reasons.sayings: Weli nooc warqad ma jiro. Warqad dhexdeeda dhamaad kasta mar keliya ayaa muuqan lahaa, tallaabada tartiibta leh ee "Show the ending" ayaa lumi lahayd. Maahmaahyada shaashadda ka akhriya wada, ama kuwa aad labaduba garanaysaan qaarkood wadaag.
